text: Bitcoin's modest pullback of 1.9% sits in contrast to Ethereum's steeper 4% decline, suggesting selective pressure on altcoins as traders rotate toward larger positions or cash. Fear and Greed at 32 reflects genuine caution despite rising slightly over the week, while Bitcoin dominance holding firm at 59.7% indicates confidence hasn't fully broken toward risk-off sentiment. The $78B in 24-hour volume remains reasonable, neither panic-flush nor capitulation, pointing to a consolidation phase rather than a directional breakdown.
